attributes.action: STOP BMA PLAN B subscription based means tested treatments
attributes.additional_details: The BMA GPs Committee for England (GPC England) will ballot GPs in England on a ‘Plan B’, or an alternative strategy for general practice that would allow GPs greater freedom to provide private services to their patients. This follows the passing of a resolution at UK LMC Conference earlier this month that called for the consideration of a means-tested, subscription-based service, This would mean before patients being treated they would be means tested and lead to a a 2 tier service
attributes.background: The BMA GPs Committee for England have balloted GPs in England on Plan B’, or an alternative strategy would allow GPs greater freedom called for the consideration of a means-tested, subscription-based service, I call on the government to urgently meet The BMA to stop this happening

rejection.details:
This petition is about a ballot being conducted by the BMA.

You may wish to sign this open petition:
'Provide more funding to support GPs'
https://petition.parliament.uk/petitions/771159
